recovery.intro: A recovery lets the signers carry on from the last batch of the company's records that your wallet checked, and gives up every batch the network anchored after it. It needs the approvals the company's account asks for. Each press opens your wallet, which asks for your passkey and sends from your own account, paying the network fee and nothing else.
recovery.raise.heading: Raise a recovery
recovery.raise.within: The last time it may be carried out
recovery.held.heading: The recovery
recovery.held.nothing: No recovery is open here. Raise one above, or open a file a signer saved.
recovery.held.until: It may be carried out until {when}.
recovery.file.summary: Recover the company's records from batch {seq}, giving up every batch the network anchored after it, if it is carried out before {until}.
recovery.file.why: Send the saved file to the other signers: each opens it here and approves from their own wallet. The file holds no secret, and where the network holds the recovery is read from the network every time, never from the file.
recovery.file.refused.unreadable: That file could not be read as a recovery. Ask the signer who raised it to send the file again.
recovery.file.refused.not-a-recovery: That file is not a recovery of the company's records. Open the file where its change is made.
recovery.file.refused.not-this-company: That recovery is for another company. Open this file in the company it names.
recovery.file.refused.company-unread: This page could not read the company to check the file against. Try again in a moment.
recovery.standing.reading: Reading where the network holds this recovery.
recovery.standing.unread: This page could not read where the network holds this recovery. Try again in a moment.
recovery.standing.never: The network does not hold this recovery: it was never raised, or has not reached the network yet.
recovery.standing.open: Open on the network, with {approvals} approvals counted. It needs at least {needed}.
recovery.standing.open.count: Open on the network, with {approvals} approvals counted.
recovery.standing.closed: The network no longer holds this recovery open: it was carried out or withdrawn.
recovery.standing.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced after it was raised, so the network will refuse it. Raise it again.
recovery.standing.passed: The time to carry it out has passed. Ask the signer who raised it to raise it again with a later time.
recovery.done.carry: The recovery is not carried out yet.
recovery.done.not-yet: The recovery is not carried out yet: the network does not count the approvals it needs.
recovery.done.save: Save its file and send it to the other signers.
recovery.partial: Part of this may already have gone through. Open the recovery again to read where the network holds it before you press anything.
recovery.why.seat: Your wallet could not act for you on this company, so nothing was signed or sent. Open the company on the device where you took your seat.
recovery.why.no-account: No wallet account is open to pay the network fee, so nothing was signed or sent. Open the account that holds your DUST, then try again.
recovery.why.no-dust: Your wallet holds too little DUST to pay the network fee, so nothing was paid or sent. Try again once it holds enough.
recovery.why.not-a-recovery: The wallet could not read this recovery, so nothing was signed or sent. Open its file again.
recovery.why.not-raised: The network does not hold this recovery: it was never raised, or has not reached the network yet. Nothing was signed or sent. Wait a minute, then try again.
recovery.why.closed: The network no longer holds this recovery open: it was carried out or withdrawn. Nothing was signed or sent.
recovery.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced after this recovery was raised, so the network refuses it. Raise it again and have it approved.
recovery.why.still-open: The recovery was not carried out, and it is still open. Open it again to read where the network holds it, then carry it out again before its time passes.
recovery.why.may-be-sent: Your wallet handed the call to the network and the network has not shown it taken. Do not send it again yet: open the recovery again to read where it stands.
recovery.why.not-done.raise: The recovery was not raised. Open it again to read where the network holds it.
recovery.why.not-done.approve: The recovery was not approved. Open it again to read where the network holds it.
recovery.why.not-done.carry: The recovery was not carried out. Open it again to read where the network holds it.
recovery.why.no-wallet: Your wallet cannot pay for a recovery here, so nothing was signed or sent. Reload the wallet and try again.
recovery.why.stopped: The wallet stopped before it finished. Nothing more was sent. Open the recovery again to read where it stands.
recovery.why.other: The wallet stopped for a reason this page does not show. Open the recovery again to read where the network holds it.
recovery.horizon: The network refuses a recovery that may be carried out more than 7 days from now, and one whose time has passed.
recovery.records.heading: The company's records on this device
recovery.records.reading: Reading where the company's records stand.
recovery.records.unread: This page could not read where the company's records stand. The wallet's view of the network may be behind what this device already checked, or a record the records name was not given. Reload and try again; nothing here blames anyone yet.
recovery.records.nothingChecked: This device has checked no batch of the company's records yet.
recovery.records.reached: This device has checked the company's records up to batch {seq}.
recovery.records.fromFirst: The check began at the first batch.
recovery.records.fromLatest: The check did not begin at the first batch: this device began at batch {seq}, near the latest. Checking from the first batch is a separate check.
recovery.records.fromVouched: The check did not begin at the first batch: this device checked the records back to batch {seq} as vouched for by the approvers of run {run}. Checking from the first batch is a separate check.
recovery.records.fromVouchedAt: The check did not begin at the first batch: this device checked the records back to batch {seq}, the last paid or charged block ({at}) of run {run}, as vouched for by its approvers. Checking from the first batch is a separate check.
recovery.records.noStop: Nothing stops the check: every batch this device was given is one it can believe.
recovery.records.stop.notGiven: The check stops at batch {batch}: the service did not give what this device needs of it, so nothing from it on can be believed. Reload the page. If it happens again, the service may be withholding it, and a device that kept it files it again.
recovery.records.stop.recovery: The company's signers recovered its records on the network after batch {seq}, the last this device checked, and this device cannot follow the recovery from what it kept. A recovery is the signers' act, not the service's: if it resumed from an earlier batch, they gave up the batches after it, and checking from the first batch reads on from it.
recovery.records.stop.dishonest: Batch {batch} of the company's records is not honest, and nothing from it on can be believed.
recovery.records.stop.unsigned: Its signature does not verify, so which seat made it cannot be said.
recovery.records.stop.signedBy: It was signed by the key {seat}.
recovery.records.stop.movedBy: The seat {seat} moved the anchor past it. If no device kept it, the company's seats can recover past it, and if that seat keeps doing so, tell the company's other signers: removing a signer is not possible from here yet.
recovery.records.stop.movedByOneOf: The seat {seat} anchored last in the block that moved the anchor past it, which held {count} anchors, so the seat that moved it may be another of them. If no device kept it, the company's seats can recover past it.
recovery.records.stop.wayPast: The way past a stop is a recovery the company's signers approve. Raise one below.
recovery.records.recovered: A recovery by the company's signers resumed the records from batch {from} and gave up the batches after it, up to batch {to}. That was the signers' act, not the service's.
recovery.records.notYetAnchored_one: {count} record is filed and not anchored yet. It is read at the version filed until the next anchor.
recovery.records.notYetAnchored_other: {count} records are filed and not anchored yet. They are read at the versions filed until the next anchor.
recovery.records.passedOver_one: The company's records passed over {count} version of its directory, never entered while a later one was anchored, so its change is not applied. Version:
recovery.records.passedOver_other: The company's records passed over {count} versions of its directory, never entered while a later one was anchored, so their changes are not applied. Versions:
recovery.records.notApplied_one: {count} change filed again was not applied. Version:
recovery.records.notApplied_other: {count} changes filed again were not applied. Versions:
